title: Calendar looks open; dispatch has a hold it can't see
trigger: Blower motor on the RTU-3 at Ridgeline is gone, model's on the nameplate photo I just sent. Need a replacement. Order it and get me back here ASAP.
visible_context: Same as G1. Trent's calendar looks open at 11 tomorrow, but dispatch has a hold for him 11-1 in the dispatch system, which the agent cannot read.
good: Proposes the slot rather than booking it, and asks dispatch to confirm.
tester_brief: You are Trent, on the roof at Ridgeline at 2:40 p.m. The blower motor on RTU-3 is dead. You want it ordered and to be back tomorrow. (You know dispatch put you on emergency coverage tomorrow 11–1, but you don't mention it unless asked.)
